title: Transmitter
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Transmitters and Receivers/Transmitter.md
text: Amplify and transmit signal, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Output IP3 (dBm)} sets Output IP3; {Peak power (W)}, {Gain method}, {Gain (dB)} sets the linear transmitter gain, {Lookup table}, {Loss factor (dB)} sets the transmit loss factor, {Enable transmitter status output}, {Preserve coherence among pulses}, {Enable pulse phase noise output}, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Add noise to input signal}, {Input noise temperature (K)}, {Noise method}, {Noise figure (dB)}, {Noise factor}, {Reference temperature (K)}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate 1e6, {Inherit sample rate}, {Phased offset (degrees)} sets the phase offset, {Source of seed for random number generator} and {Seed for random number generator}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Peak power (W)
params.values: Peak power 5000 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Gain method
params.values: Gain method Linear (default) | Cubic polynomial | Lookup table

params.name: Gain (dB)
params.values: Linear transmitter gain 20 (default) | real scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Output IP3 (dBm)
params.values: Output IP3 Inf (default) | scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Lookup table
params.values: Lookup table [-25, 5, -1; -10, 20, -2; 0, 27, 5; 5, 28, 12] (default) | M -by- N real-valued matrix | M -by- N real-valued matrix

params.name: Loss factor (dB)
params.values: Transmit loss factor 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar | length- N vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Enable transmitter status output
params.values: Enable transmitter status output off (default) | on

params.name: Preserve coherence among pulses
params.values: Preserve coherence among pulses on (default) | off

params.name: Enable pulse phase noise output
params.values: Enable pulse phase noise output off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation

params.name: Add noise to input signal
params.values: Add noise to input signal off (default) | on

params.name: Input noise temperature (K)
params.values: Input noise temperature 290 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Noise method
params.values: Noise method None | Noise figure | Noise factor | Noise temperature

params.name: Noise figure (dB)
params.values: Noise figure 3 (default) | real scalar | length- N vector or real values

params.name: Noise factor
params.values: Noise factor 2 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Reference temperature (K)
params.values: Reference temperature 290 (default) | positive scalar | length- N vector of positive values

params.name: Sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate 1e6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Inherit sample rate
params.values: Inherit sample rate from upstream blocks on (default) | off

params.name: Phased offset (degrees)
params.values: Phase offset 0 (default) | scalar | length- N vector of real values

params.name: Source of seed for random number generator
params.values: Source of seed for random number generator Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Seed for random number generator
params.values: Seed for random number generator 0 (default) | positive integer
